title: Internal sample pack (drone4d.bench.sample_pack.v1)
description: D3-AC-56 (sample pack browsable in the internal workspace); AWR-05 §10.2 P0a deliverable; AWR-14 §21.22; AWR-17 §18.8.3, §18.8.4 (contracts 1.3.0, d1 V0.3). One representative run per observation-level group and reference baseline of the formal mbl_e2e round (median-EC seed of repeat 1): event replay (tracks_obs.bin plus the event tape), private-view video of every UAV, raw MCAP, evaluation and run manifest. Written by tools/bench/d3/sample_pack.py to <data_root>/samples/<pack_id>/pack.json; returned by bench-api GET /samples (researcher, {items: [pack...]}); parsed by apps/web/src/ui/lab/replay/samplePack.ts, which tolerates unknown fields. File paths are relative to the run's derived/ directory and are downloaded through BN-54 GET /runs/{rid}/artifacts/{path}. The document never carries seeds or seed indices.
